text: I checked it out. So far, looks decent. but you gave it only two options, one being static other being hollow. but what about items that have physics like a barrel already does from the current prop stack
resolution: Fixed the Compile dialog's missing third prop nature. The first cut offered only Static (solid/blocks) vs Foliage (walk-through) and missed the prop stack's kickable PHYSICS bodies — the KICKPROP dynamics system (steelDrum/cans/balls/cones carry dynamics:{bodyRadiusMeters,restitution}). Replaced the solid toggle + 2-option donor with a single Nature selector (Static / Foliage / Physics) that maps the user's mental model onto the table's granular fields. A Physics prop authors only the bounce (restitution 0..1, via a stepper); the cook MEASURES the body radius from the footprint (derive-don't-store-twice per GUIDING_LIGHT) and emits dynamics:{bodyRadiusMeters=footprintRadius, restitution}. Changed PropDescriptorInput.dynamics → physics:{restitution}; fillPropDescriptor builds the measured dynamics; validateProp rejects a restitution outside 0..1 or a zero body radius (fail loud). cookedAsset 13/13 (+3: physics body measured, static carries no dynamics, bad bounce rejected); store 8, editMesh 48, modelStream 8, textureize 9 all green; Studio + sources bundle clean; fully hot-reloadable. Spec Part 7.6 + the build log + the memory updated. NB the user's barrel example is actually static in the current stack (steelDrum is the dynamic drum) but the gap was real. Uncommitted by the user's lead.
